parts.name: frame body

physics.Basic_description: Dark grey, matte-finished C-shaped metal body forming the main backbone of the clamp.
physics.Functional_description: Provides the rigid structural frame that resists the clamping force generated by the screw.
physics.Grasped_description: Grasp the vertical spine or the top horizontal arm of the C-frame with a parallel jaw gripper.
physics.reason: C-clamp frames are typically solid cast iron or forged steel to withstand high compressive loads without bending.

parts.description: Dark grey, matte-finished C-shaped metal body forming the main backbone of the clamp.
parts.function: Provides the rigid structural frame that resists the clamping force generated by the screw.

parts.name: anvil pad

physics.Basic_description: Small, light grey circular metal pad located on the inner face of the fixed jaw.
physics.Functional_description: Provides a flat, hard contact surface for the workpiece against the stationary side of the clamp.
physics.Grasped_description: Too small and recessed to be a primary grasp target; avoid grasping.
physics.reason: Small metal insert or machined surface, effectively solid material.

parts.description: Small, light grey circular metal pad located on the inner face of the fixed jaw.
parts.function: Provides a flat, hard contact surface for the workpiece against the stationary side of the clamp.

parts.name: screw core

physics.Basic_description: Light grey cylindrical threaded rod running through the center of the clamp frame.
physics.Functional_description: Translates rotational force from the handle into linear clamping pressure.
physics.Grasped_description: Do not grasp the threads directly as it may damage them or slip; grasp the handle instead.
physics.reason: Clamp screws are solid steel rods to prevent buckling under compression.

parts.description: Light grey cylindrical threaded rod running through the center of the clamp frame.
parts.function: Translates rotational force from the handle into linear clamping pressure.

parts.name: screw collar

physics.Basic_description: Small metallic ring or collar section near the handle hub, appearing light grey/blue in segmentation.
physics.Functional_description: Acts as a spacer or retaining ring for the handle assembly on the screw shaft.
physics.Grasped_description: Too small and integral to the mechanism to be grasped independently.
physics.reason: Small machined metal component, likely solid or thick-walled enough to treat as solid for mass estimation.

parts.description: Small metallic ring or collar section near the handle hub, appearing light grey/blue in segmentation.
parts.function: Acts as a spacer or retaining ring for the handle assembly on the screw shaft.

parts.name: handle hub

physics.Basic_description: Central cylindrical block connecting the handle bar to the screw, light grey/metallic appearance.
physics.Functional_description: Transfers torque from the handle bar to the screw core.
physics.Grasped_description: Can be grasped if the handle bar is obstructed, but the bar offers better leverage.
physics.reason: Solid metal block required to transmit torque without deformation.

parts.description: Central cylindrical block connecting the handle bar to the screw, light grey/metallic appearance.
parts.function: Transfers torque from the handle bar to the screw core.

parts.name: handle bar

physics.Basic_description: Horizontal cylindrical bar at the top of the clamp, appearing light grey in RGB.
physics.Functional_description: Provides leverage for the user to rotate the screw and tighten the clamp.
physics.Grasped_description: Primary grasp target; grip the bar perpendicular to its axis to apply torque.
physics.reason: Handle bars are solid metal rods to resist bending during tightening.

parts.description: Horizontal cylindrical bar at the top of the clamp, appearing light grey in RGB.
parts.function: Provides leverage for the user to rotate the screw and tighten the clamp.

parts.name: handle caps

physics.Basic_description: Small rounded caps at the ends of the handle bar, appearing light grey/white, likely plastic or rubber.
physics.Functional_description: Protects the user's hands from sharp metal edges and provides a comfortable grip surface.
physics.Grasped_description: Can be grasped at the very ends of the handle, though the metal bar is preferred for torque.
physics.reason: Small molded plastic/rubber caps, effectively solid for manipulation purposes.

parts.description: Small rounded caps at the ends of the handle bar, appearing light grey/white, likely plastic or rubber.
parts.function: Protects the user's hands from sharp metal edges and provides a comfortable grip surface.

parts.name: swivel pad

physics.Basic_description: Circular disc at the tip of the screw, light grey metallic finish.
physics.Functional_description: Swivels to apply even pressure to the workpiece without rotating the workpiece itself.
physics.Grasped_description: Not a grasp target; it is the active contact point for clamping.
physics.reason: Solid metal disc designed to withstand direct compressive force.

parts.description: Circular disc at the tip of the screw, light grey metallic finish.
parts.function: Swivels to apply even pressure to the workpiece without rotating the workpiece itself.

simulation.collision: CoACD convex decomposition of concave source collision meshes (relative tolerance 0.03–0.05)
simulation.inertia: Source URDF link inertials; missing inertials use geometry-derived defaults (density 1000 kg/m³)
simulation.friction: Source URDF mu1 as sliding friction; torsional 0.005, rolling 0.0001
simulation.contact: MuJoCo soft contacts (solref 0.01 1); source restitution is displayed, not converted
simulation.material: Rigid bodies; Young’s modulus and Poisson ratio are annotations, not soft-body parameters

interaction.description: Switchable virtual joint damping and reflected armature for interactive inspection; source properties are unchanged.
interaction.rule: damping ≥ rated effort / rated speed; armature = 2% child subtree mass (slide) or 2% mass × collision radius² (hinge)

collisionFilter.description: Self-contact excluded between directly connected rigid groups, including the fixed base; nonadjacent contacts retained
